description: This Java class implements a service for reading report mailing job configurations from a database, including methods to retrieve all configurations and a specific configuration by name.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobConfigurationReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a service to read report mailing job configurations from the database.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobConfigurationMapper

methods.name: retrieveAllReportMailingJobConfigurations

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJobConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific report mailing job configuration by name, throws exception if not found.
